question: The Prevention of Seditious Meetings Act was passed in __________ by colonial Government.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1907**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Prevention of Seditious Meetings Act** was passed in the year **1907** by the colonial Government.
 
• This act was enacted to curb the activities that could lead to seditious meetings and was aimed at suppressing nationalist activities.
 
• It was part of a series of measures taken by the British
